checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Lit amber candle is centered and the largest, brightest element.
Glass and gold lid edges are crisp; the wick and flame look natural.
Only the candle, lid, and dried flowers/lavender as props.

must.item: Controlled lighting and coordinated background, polished retail look
must.why: Warm light on dark marble with gold and amber tones looks premium.

faults.what: Resolution is low at 640px, so it is soft for retail use.
The gold lid sits beside the jar instead of on it, and it looks like a second container. This is slightly odd.
The dried flowers at the left edge are cropped.

summary: A premium-looking lit amber candle with a brushed gold lid on dark marble, warmly lit and clean; the main drawbacks are the low 640px resolution and the lid standing beside the jar like a second container.
